units.title: Opening greeting (own words)
units.text: Open the call in your own words. Sample: thank the caller for calling Harbor Health, give your first name and say this is the pharmacy education line, confirm they are calling about a prescription on a Medicare Advantage plan, say the call may be monitored, and ask how you can help.
units.source_span: Thanks for calling Harbor Health. This is [first name] on the pharmacy education line. You are calling about a prescription on a Medicare Advantage plan, and this call may be monitored. What can I help you with?

units.title: Skip long intro when IVR captured the drug
units.text: If the caller already told the IVR the drug, skip the long intro. Confirm the spelling of the drug and which pharmacy they want to use.
units.source_span: Advocate note: Skip the long intro if they already told the IVR the drug. Just confirm spelling of the drug and which pharmacy they want to use.

units.title: Verification requirements
units.text: Ask for the member ID plus either date of birth or address.
units.source_span: Ask for the member ID plus either date of birth or address.

units.title: Caregiver authorization required
units.text: Caregivers need an authorization on the account before any drug or price talk.
units.source_span: Caregivers need an authorization on the account before any drug or price talk.

units.title: Unverified callers get callback offer only
units.text: Unverified callers get a callback offer only.
units.source_span: Unverified callers get a callback offer only.

units.title: Read price disclaimer before any dollar figure
units.text: Read the price disclaimer word for word before giving any dollar figure.
units.source_span: Read word for word before any dollar figure.

units.title: Price estimate disclaimer
units.text: The price I quote is an estimate for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, using the plan records I can see today. What you pay can change if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.
units.source_span: The price I quote is an estimate for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, using the plan records I can see today. What you pay can change if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.

units.title: Answering whether the estimate is the copay
units.text: If the member asks whether the quoted number is the copay, say it reflects what the plan record shows for copay or coinsurance. Do not promise the register price.
units.source_span: Advocate note: If they ask whether that number is the copay, say it reflects what the plan record shows for copay or coinsurance. Do not promise the register price.

units.title: Offer 90-day mail order on first fill for maintenance drugs
units.text: For a maintenance drug, offer a 90-day mail-order supply on the first fill.
units.source_span: For a maintenance drug, offer a 90-day mail-order supply on the first fill.

units.title: No retail fills required before mail order
units.text: The member does not need any retail fills first before using 90-day mail order for a maintenance drug.
units.source_span: The member does not need any retail fills first.

units.title: Specialty drugs stay at Harbor Specialty Pharmacy
units.text: Specialty drugs stay at Harbor Specialty Pharmacy and are not converted to mail order on this call.
units.source_span: Specialty drugs stay at Harbor Specialty Pharmacy and are not converted to mail order on this call.

units.title: Closing statement
units.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for calling Harbor Health. We appreciate you trusting us with your coverage.
units.source_span: Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for calling Harbor Health. We appreciate you trusting us with your coverage.

units.title: Call summary available in member portal
units.text: A call summary shows in the member portal within two business days.
units.source_span: A call summary shows in the member portal within two business days.

units.title: How to mention the call summary
units.text: Mention the portal call summary in your own words only, with no extra price or network comment.
units.source_span: Add that in your own words only, with no extra price or network comment.
